glossary.ja: キング・オブ・ハート
glossary.role: Shuffle Alliance title held by Domon Kasshu (formerly Master Asia).
Domon's older brother and a Neo Japan scientist; co-developer of the Ultimate Gundam, later the Devil Gundam's core unit.
glossary.personality: Kind and gentle; loves his younger brother and taught him to have faith in others.

glossary.role: Neo Japan Gundam Fighter (Shining Gundam, then God Gundam); King of Hearts and leader of the Shuffle Alliance
glossary.personality: Hot-blooded, brash, impulsive and impatient; socially awkward, but has a strong sense of justice. Prone to loud battle cries.

glossary.role: G Gundam term for Gundam Fight mecha (Devil Gundam, Master Gundam...).
Gon Jem's irregular unit, nicknamed the "Filth of Giganos"
Self-evolving, self-repairing, self-replicating rogue Gundam (JDG-00X); main antagonist machine of G Gundam
Giganos hardliner; as Lieutenant Colonel he assassinates Marshal Guiltorre and becomes Supreme Leader of Giganos; pilots a black Gilgazamune at the end
glossary.personality: Arrogant, power-hungry, cruel and treacherous; bullies subordinates; strong MA pilot but a poor commander

glossary.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing / Endless Waltz
glossary.role: Mobile suit pilot and former OZ Specials instructor; Preventer agent ('Preventer Fire'); Zechs's devoted partner. ACE2 calls her ノイン特尉 (Preventer rank).
glossary.personality: Mature, composed, slightly tomboyish; an idealist who dislikes war, but fights hard for those she believes in. Fiercely loyal to Zechs.

glossary.note: Op 01 uses 'unit' for mecha in general, 'machine' when the speaker is the developer

33.speaker: Kouichiro Misumaru
33.evidence: brief: '私はＵＣＥ宇宙軍提督のミスマルだ。'

36.speaker: Lucrezia Noin
36.role: tactical staff officer (特尉, Special Lieutenant) from the Preventer
36.evidence: m6112#36 Sinapus: 'ノイン特尉、後で詳しく聞かせてくれ' then p36 explains Domon in brief63178#4-9; commanding but female, do not masculinize

37.speaker: Eyphar Sinapus
37.evidence: brief: '私が本艦の艦長、エイパー・シナプスだ。'

report.translator_summary: Translated batch op11_02 (63 rows), concluding Operation 11. Covers the fall of the Gon Jem Squad (Jin and Gol killed, Min's defiant struggle), Domon Kasshu's sudden entrance with the God Finger seeking Kyoji, the battle against Gon Jem in the prototype Gilgazamune, the debriefing with Misumaru, Noin (explaining the Devil Gundam and Kyoji Kasshu), and Sinapus, and the UCE Intelligence report on the activation of the Giganos Space Mobile Fortress.

uncertainties.issue: Min's defiant line 'あたいはあきらめないよ！' translated with her characteristic scrappy phrasing ('Well, I ain't givin' up!').
Domon's iconic special attack cry 'ばぁくねぇつ！ ゴッドフィンガァァー！！' translated as 'Erupting... God Fiiingeeer!!'.
Noin's explanation of Devil Gundam and Kyoji preserved with serious military officer tone while maintaining her female character.
